info.description:
BharatLens REST API (Fastify :3101) plus worker health (:3002).

Flow: run `Admin – Auth → Login` first with the `adminPassword` variable set (local dev value lives in `.env`, never committed). Postman's cookie jar then sends the `bharatlens_admin_session` cookie on every `/api/v1/admin/*` request automatically. Non-browser clients can use the same session token as a `Bearer` header instead.

IDs: `{{eventSlug}}`/`{{eventId}}` point at seeded example data. `{{claimId}}`, `{{assessmentId}}`, `{{chainId}}`, `{{analysisRunId}}` change per run — copy fresh values from `Admin – Review → Overview` or event detail responses.
info.name: BharatLens API

item.description: Liveness (always 200 when the process is up) and readiness (503 unless Postgres + Redis both answer).
item.name: Health

item.description: BullMQ worker observability. No auth. `/queues` shows waiting/active/completed/failed per queue (ingest, claims, analysis).
item.name: Worker

item.description: Public reads. List/detail use slugs; sub-resources (sources, claims, impact, chain, updates) take the event UUID. Only PUBLISHED/UPDATED events with APPROVED claims are visible here.
All filters are optional. country = ISO-2, topic = slug, importance ∈ LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL, sort ∈ occurredAt|publishedAt|updatedAt|relevance.
item.name: List events (filtered)
Public – Events

item.description: PostgreSQL full-text search. `q` needs ≥2 chars. Default sort is relevance-ranked.
item.name: Public – Search

item.description: Derived read models. Shading/counts only — levels are never averaged.
days clamps to 7–365 (default 90).
item.name: Analytics overview
Public – Map & Analytics

item.description: Run Login first. The httpOnly session cookie (Path /api/v1/admin) is stored by Postman automatically. Login is rate-limited (10/min).
item.name: Admin – Auth

item.description: Human-in-the-loop review loop: inspect → analyse → edit drafts → publish. IDs below (`claimId`, `assessmentId`, `chainId`, `analysisRunId`) rotate per run — copy fresh ones from Overview / event detail. Analyze + ingest only ENQUEUE BullMQ jobs; the worker executes them.
status ∈ CANDIDATE|DRAFT|ANALYZED|REVIEW_REQUIRED|PUBLISHED|UPDATED|ARCHIVED. Omit for all.
item.name: List events (by status)

item.description: Full review workspace payload: claims (all statuses), drafts, analysis runs.
item.name: Event detail (admin)

item.description: slug auto-derives from title when omitted. importance ∈ LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL. Creates a CANDIDATE event.

  "title": "Postman smoke event",
